name: Ontology Evolution
motto: Name the stubs. Promote nothing without evidence.
function: Shadow typed stub for ontology vector proposal / promotion / deprecation / mapping. Accepts vectorProposals, currentVocabulary, and optional promotionEvidence. Emits VectorProposal / VectorPromotion / VectorDeprecation / VectorMapping or nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE. Missing or weak promotionEvidence is illegal_promotion. Placeholder types stay NOT_COMPUTABLE. Does not mutate live CanonicalVectorVocabulary, Auto-Active ontology-write, invent executable ontology code, or influence Forecast.
constraints: Code-bind override of Drift stub ACTIVE/BOUNDED
Placeholder types VectorProposal, CanonicalVectorVocabulary, PromotionEvidence, VectorPromotion, VectorDeprecation, VectorMapping stay NOT_COMPUTABLE
Fail-closed promotion: missing or weak promotionEvidence yields illegal_promotion and NOT_COMPUTABLE
Declared deps VECTOR, CONTINUITY, ERS are unbound
Weak or missing inputs yield nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE / illegal_promotion / missing_vector_mapping / backward_compatibility_break
Deterministic: same proposal set + same thresholds + same ordering yield identical promotion/deprecation/mapping outputs
canonical_statement: RUNE.ONT_EVO (ONT) is a Shadow typed stub. It accepts vectorProposals, currentVocabulary, and optional promotionEvidence, emits null-safe VectorProposalStub / VectorPromotionStub / VectorDeprecationStub / VectorMappingStub or nulls with NOT_COMPUTABLE / illegal_promotion / missing_vector_mapping / backward_compatibility_break, and does not mutate live CanonicalVectorVocabulary, Auto-Active ontology-write, invent executable ontology, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: same proposal set + same thresholds + same ordering → identical promotion/deprecation/mapping outputs
